title: Muse: a personal agent behind Privilege

glossary.definition: Whether a persona may call a tool at all. The first gate after detection.
The business rule inside an allowed call, such as a payment limit or an export row cap.

Two PingOne Authorize rules on the airline booking tool: yours (no tickets bought by an AI agent over your limit, $500 by default) and the airline's (only premium members over $750; the tier is the PingOne user attribute airlineMemberTier, read by Authorize). Mock simulates them; Real reads the gateway's answer. The Test controls card sets the tier (Premier Gold, Premier Silver or no tier) and the agent spend limit in dollars (the PingOne attribute agentSpendLimit; an empty field means the default): in Mock it sets the simulated member and limit, in Real it writes the PingOne attributes on the demo users and reads them back.

muse.ai can book through the Airline Connector: list_flights shows the invented catalogue, book_flight sends only the flight id to the gateway. The two booking rules decide: a booking within your dollar limit goes straight through to the airline server and muse.ai gets the server's answer back; over your limit it is blocked, with your limit and the fare in the message; otherwise it is held for approval. Nothing is booked unless the airline server's answer says booked true. Authorize first checks that you let this agent act for you; the connector passes on the consent you gave at sign-in, and the pre-approval for a booking within your limit, only when its owner has set up the consent bridge (and, for a limit above $500, the test controls), otherwise the booking is denied for missing consent or held.
A detection flow in front of the gateway. It flags bursts of calls and instructions hidden in tool arguments. Simulated here.

cards.label: Trigger Muse-detect
cards.description: Send seven calls in a row and watch the seventh held.

cards.label: Staff cannot pay
cards.description: Sign in as staff and try a payment. The coarse check blocks it before any amount is checked.

cards.label: Two rules can stop a booking
cards.description: Book a flight as an AI agent or as Sam directly. Your rule stops agent tickets over your limit ($500); the airline's rule stops anyone but premium members over $750 (the tier comes from the PingOne user, a missing tier is not premium). Exactly $500 and $750 pass, and both rules are listed when both fail. Use the Test controls card to switch Premier Gold and Premier Silver, or to set the agent limit ($250, $500, $1000 or your own amount), and run the booking again.

cards.label: Book a flight from muse.ai
cards.description: In muse.ai, list the flights, book SH106 (an AI agent cannot buy over your limit), then SH101 (passes both rules and is within your limit, so it goes straight through). Real mode, owner-run.

cards.label: Big payments need a person
cards.description: A payment over 500 is held until approved (simulated CIBA).
